phases.name: Autonomous Execution Enhancement
phases.description:
Eliminate repetition after "proceed" commands. Implement autonomous
continuation detection, ASCII progress bars, minimal status updates,
and single decision gate. Enables true autonomous multi-phase execution.

phases.name: ML-Based Summarization (Pragmatic Subset)
phases.description:
✅ COMPLETE: Production-ready ML summarization with graceful degradation.
3 stages complete: ExtractiveSummarizer (10 tests), ModelManager (9 tests),
FallbackPipeline (8 tests).
Achieves 10-20% additional reduction over Phase 34 deduplication.
4-tier fallback: ML_EXTRACTIVE → DEDUPLICATION → POLICY_BASED → RAW.
<100ms performance validated.

Deferred: AbstractiveSummarizer (BART/T5 1.6GB+ models), HybridSummarizer,
Cloud APIs (low ROI vs download cost).
